capabilities: Search IMA notes by title or content with pagination
Browse IMA notebook directories and drill into notes
Render IMA notes in a sidebar with Markdown rendering
Import IMA notes into the vault as .md files
Navigate back and forward between viewed pages
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Setup requires creating an app on the ima.qq.com Open Platform to obtain credentials.
problem: IMA notes live in Tencent's knowledge base service, outside the vault, with no way to search or bring them into Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Integrate IMA knowledge base with your vault.

requires.name: IMA Open Platform Client ID and API Key

summary: Integrates the Tencent IMA knowledge base, letting you search, browse, read, and import IMA notes as Markdown files inside Obsidian.
